# 📺 Padang TV Auto-Generated M3U Playlist & EPG

[![GitHub Pages](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub%20Pages-Active-success?logo=github)](https://sulthanpamenan.github.io/padang-tv-playlist/)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
[![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/Live%20TV-Active-blue)](#-key-features)

An automated M3U playlist and XMLTV EPG provider for **Padang TV** live streaming. Designed for seamless 24/7 playback on all major IPTV players.

---

## 🔗 Live URLs

Import these links directly into your IPTV application (TiviMate, OTT Navigator, VLC, Televizo, etc.):

| Content | URL | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stream Link (TXT)** *(Recommended)* | `https://sulthanpamenan.github.io/padang-tv-playlist/playlist.txt` | Direct live stream URL |
| **Playlist (M3U)** | `https://sulthanpamenan.github.io/padang-tv-playlist/playlist.m3u` | Standard M3U playlist format with logo and metadata |
| **EPG (XMLTV)** | `https://sulthanpamenan.github.io/padang-tv-playlist/epg.xml` | Electronic Program Guide containing broadcast schedules |

---

## ✨ Key Features

* **Auto-Updated Stream:** Automated link updates to ensure reliable 24/7 stream playback.
* **Rich EPG Metadata:** Detailed program titles, episode descriptions, categories, and logos.
* **Universal Compatibility:** Fully standardized format for all M3U & XMLTV supported IPTV players.
* **No VPN Required:** Playable directly across local and international networks.

---

## 🚀 Quick Setup Guide

1. Open your IPTV application (e.g., **TiviMate** or **OTT Navigator**).
2. Add a new **M3U Playlist** and enter the playlist URL:
   `https://sulthanpamenan.github.io/padang-tv-playlist/playlist.m3u`
3. Add the **EPG Source** and enter the TV Guide URL:
   `https://sulthanpamenan.github.io/padang-tv-playlist/epg.xml`
4. Reload your playlist and TV Guide to start watching.
